About this role

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/x), you’ll join Eye Security at an exciting stage of growth and play a key role in shaping how we attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent across Europe.

This is more than a recruitment role. It’s an opportunity to help build and scale a Talent Acquisition function that acts as a true strategic partner to the business.

We believe in quality over quantity. You’ll partner closely with Hiring Managers and business leaders to solve hiring challenges, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge assumptions when needed, and continuously raise the bar, not only in who we hire, but in how we hire.

Beyond owning end-to-end recruitment processes, you’ll take ownership of initiatives that strengthen our Talent Acquisition function, from improving hiring processes and assessment frameworks to employer branding, sourcing strategies, and other projects that enable us to scale sustainably across Europe.

We’re looking for someone who naturally takes initiative, enjoys building, and is excited to elevate the function to the next level.

This is a hybrid role based in our Berlin office.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Hiring Managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs, shape hiring strategies, and act as a trusted advisor throughout the recruitment process.

  • Own end-to-end recruitment across a variety of technical and business roles, from sourcing through offer acceptance, with a strong focus on quality and candidate experience.

  • Design and continuously improve recruitment processes, including structured interviews, competency-based assessments, scorecards, and feedback loops.

  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies and build strong talent pipelines by engaging passive candidates and exploring new channels.

  • Use data and market insights to guide hiring decisions, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously optimize recruitment performance.

  • Take ownership of Talent Acquisition initiatives beyond day-to-day hiring, such as employer branding, recruitment operations, hiring manager enablement, recruiting events, and process improvements.

 

What We Offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • A remote-friendly culture with regular company-wide get-togethers, giving you the opportunity to collaborate in person and build strong team connections.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full ownership of a strategic function in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

About Eye Security

Eye Security provides cybersecurity and embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with offices in Berlin, we’ve grown to over 190 employees and continue to expand internationally following our recent Series C funding round.


We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team unites professionals from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds—all driven by one mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players. As a European cybersecurity company, we believe organizations of every size deserve access to world-class protection.

At Eye, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that helps protect thousands of businesses across Europe while helping shape the future of cybersecurity on the continent.

    The Role

    Perk is building a modern, AI-powered outbound and pipeline generation motion in close partnership with Sales and Marketing leadership. The Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering function sits at the centre of this transformation, designing and operating the data infrastructure, Clay-based enrichment systems, and AI-driven workflows that enable our revenue teams to execute at scale.

    This is not a traditional RevOps or systems admin role. The Senior GTM Engineer is a hands-on builder: someone who constructs sophisticated Clay workflows from scratch, engineers AI-powered enrichment pipelines, and translates signal-based prospecting strategies into production-ready systems. As AI continues to reshape B2B sales, this role is responsible for staying ahead of the curve and identifying where LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent automation can replace manual effort and improve outbound precision.

    The role reports to the Senior Manager, Revenue Systems, and works closely with the central GTM Engineering team, Revenue Operations, and Sales leadership. It offers a direct, visible impact on how Perk builds and scales its commercial engine.


    What You’ll Do

    Clay Engineering & AI-Powered Outbound Infrastructure

    • Own the design, build, and maintenance of Clay tables, waterfall enrichment flows, and AI column logic that power Perk's outbound engine.

    • Engineer multi-step Clay workflows using webhooks, HTTP API integrations, and conditional branching to automate account and contact sourcing at scale.

    • Build and iterate on AI prompt layers within Clay using LLM columns to generate personalised outreach snippets, research account context, and qualify leads programmatically.

    • Construct and maintain signal-based prospecting systems that ingest buying triggers (hiring signals, funding events, intent data) and route them into prioritised Clay tables for Sales activation.

    • Integrate Clay with Salesforce, Outreach, and data providers (Clearbit, Apollo, LinkedIn, PredictLeads, and others) to maintain clean, enriched, and timely GTM data.

    AI Workflow Design & Automation

    • Evaluate and implement AI tooling, including LLM-based research agents, AI SDRs, and prompt-engineered enrichment flows, to scale outbound relevance without scaling headcount.

    • Design and maintain Outreach sequences that incorporate AI-generated personalisation, ensuring high-volume dialling and email campaigns feel 1:1 at scale.

    • Identify and automate repetitive GTM operations (list building, data hygiene, routing, deduplication) using Clay, Make, and custom API scripts.

    • Maintain a working knowledge of the AI GTM vendor landscape and bring forward well-reasoned recommendations on new tooling.

    Data Quality & Enrichment Architecture

    • Own TAM sourcing and enrichment workflows, building waterfall logic that sequences providers (e.g. Clearbit -> Fullenrich -> LinkedIn) to maximise contact coverage and data completeness. This includes engineering matching logic and scoring systems to accurately identify net-new accounts against existing CRM data (using identifiers like domain, LinkedIn, and country) before routing them to Sales.

    • Maintain accurate account and contact data across Salesforce and connected GTM tools, with automated hygiene rules to catch decay before it reaches Sales.

    • Define and enforce data quality standards for ICP segmentation, territory assignment, and pipeline attribution.

    GTM Systems & Sales Productivity

    • Configure and maintain the core GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Clay) to support high-volume outbound activity and ambitious pipeline targets.

    • Partner directly with Sales to diagnose productivity bottlenecks and build systems solutions, from routing logic to sequence architecture to dialler integrations.

    • Rapidly troubleshoot system and workflow failures to minimise lost selling time during core business hours.

    Cross-Functional Collaboration & Roadmap Execution

    • Serve as the primary systems contact for Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering support, owning issue resolution end-to-end.

    • Execute against the Revenue Systems roadmap in partnership with the Senior Manager and central GTM Engineering team.

    • Share learnings, workflow templates, and Clay builds with the global GTM Engineering team to drive consistency and compound improvement across regions.

    • Provide ground-level feedback to inform roadmap prioritisation, surfacing patterns in what's breaking, slowing, or blocking revenue teams.


    What We’re Looking For

    Must-Have

    • 6+ years in GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong technical orientation.

    • Hands-on Clay expertise; you have built complex Clay tables, waterfall enrichment flows, webhook integrations, and AI column prompts in a production environment, not just experimented with the tool.

    • Direct experience applying AI to GTM workflows: prompt engineering for LLM-based enrichment, AI-powered personalisation at scale, or building/evaluating AI SDR tooling.

    • Salesforce proficiency: building and maintaining custom objects, flows, reports, and data integrity logic.

    • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach or SalesLoft) and their integration with CRM and enrichment tooling.

    • Ability to work with APIs, webhooks, and lightweight automation tools (Make, Zapier, or equivalent) without requiring engineering support for every integration.

    • Strong data instincts: you build systems that keep data clean, catch decay early, and ensure Sales always operates from a high-quality foundation.

    Strong Advantage

    • Experience building signal-based outbound systems using intent data, hiring signals, or funding triggers surfaced through Clay or similar infrastructure.

    • Familiarity with data providers in the GTM stack: Clearbit, Apollo, PredictLeads, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Bombora, or similar.

    • Exposure to Gong data and using conversation intelligence to inform outbound strategy or sequence design.

    • Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment.

    • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

    • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

    • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

    • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

    • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

    • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

    • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

    • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

    • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

    • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

    • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

    • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

    • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

    • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

    • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

    About Orakl Oncology

    At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

    Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide.     About the Role

    We are looking for a Research Lead - Predictive Oncology, to build and lead a research programme to improve the translational capabilities of Orakl Oncology’s platform, and to provide the scientific backbone of O-Predict, Orakl’s predictive solutions.

    You will own O-Predict's long-term scientific roadmap, choose the questions we pursue, and lead the work needed to answer them. The opportunity combines access to Orakl's experimental and molecular data, clinical information where available, and the ability to shape future data generation with our experimental and clinical collaborators.

    This is a hands-on scientific leadership role. You will develop and test methods, mentor contributors, and build a coherent body of research with a recognisable scientific contribution. Publications, presentations and external collaborations will be integral outputs of that programme.

    You will work closely with the CTO and our Data Science, Computational Biology, experimental, product and engineering colleagues. Your research will establish which predictions are reliable, identify their limitations, and inform how O-Predict can support drug-development decisions.

    The role is suited to a researcher ready to take ownership of an independent programme within a collaborative company, including an emerging research leader with a strong record of original work.

    Own O-Predict's long-term research roadmap: define and maintain a 2-year scientific agenda, translated into a prioritised 12-month execution plan. Identify the key uncertainties, research hypotheses, data requirements, dependencies and resources; set milestones and explicit criteria for continuing, redirecting or stopping projects. Review priorities with the CTO as evidence and company needs evolve.

    Lead R&D execution: take research programmes from question formulation through method development, validation and interpretation. Coordinate agreed contributions across Data Science, Computational Biology and experimental teams, establish project ownership, run scientific reviews, resolve blockers and mentor researchers. Remain hands-on in the analyses and modelling decisions that determine scientific quality.

    Shape future data generation: identify the experiments, measurements and cohorts that would resolve important scientific uncertainties. Co-design these studies with experimental and clinical colleagues, prioritise them within the agreed research allocation, and use the results to test and revise your hypotheses.

    Advance O-Predict's predictive capabilities: investigate how drug screening, patient-derived models, molecular and clinical data can improve treatment-response and trial-outcome predictions. Assess extensions to new cohorts, indications and therapeutic settings, specifying the evidence needed before extending claims.

    Own the validation strategy: define relevant endpoints, external baselines and evaluation protocols. Lead independent and prospective validation plans with clinical and experimental collaborators, and document both performance and failure modes.

    Connect research to product development: work with product and engineering colleagues to translate promising findings into reproducible methods and clearly documented scientific requirements. Define the evidence needed for transfer into O-Predict and assess feasibility, expected value and limitations.

    Lead publications and scientific materials: build a publication and conference plan around the research roadmap. Lead manuscripts from analysis and figures through submission and reviewer responses, with contributions distributed across the research team. Produce abstracts, posters, talks and methods notes; provide scientific direction and review for partner evidence decks.

    Build substantive scientific collaborations: work directly with clinical investigators and quantitative researchers to formulate questions, co-design studies, access complementary expertise and pursue independent validation opportunities. Represent O-Predict at relevant oncology and computational conferences, present your team's research, and turn scientific discussions into joint projects and publications.

    Run publication governance: coordinate authorship and co-author review with hospital and pharmaceutical partners, track contractual publication and acknowledgement obligations, and align disclosure with confidentiality, patient-data permissions and intellectual-property considerations.

    Minimum Qualifications

    • PhD, PharmD, MD, or MSc with an equivalent research record in a quantitative or biomedical discipline relevant to predictive oncology.

    • Strong grounding in statistical inference, predictive modelling and study design; able to challenge biological assumptions and machine-learning evaluations.

    • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication in English, including manuscripts, scientific presentations and substantive discussions with external researchers.

    • Experience presenting research at oncology or computational conferences and maintaining an active scientific network.

    Why Join Orakl

    • Grow as a research leader. Mentor researchers and help shape the capabilities and future team needed to deliver the programme.

    Pelagon - Autonomous Maritime ISR

    Full-time · On-site (Marseille or Paris) · Founding team · Reports to founders

    The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer.

    Founded by Aymeric (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.

    France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service.

    Pelagon is backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised.


    The role

    As Embedded System Lead Engineer, you take end-to-end technical ownership of the hardware, electronics, and embedded stack across a small family of autonomous maritime platforms, some operating on the surface, some beneath it.

    What they share matters more than what sets them apart: each must persist at sea for long stretches, sense its surroundings, run our AI on-device, and report back intelligently — all while surviving a brutal environment on a very tight energy budget.

    You will lead their technical development, from architecture and component selection through bring-up, integration, sea trials, and iteration. You'll set the engineering bar for the platforms team and shape how we build for years to come.

    These platforms exist to carry one thing into the water: our AI. Pelagon trains high-performance detection models in-house on its own stack, and those models have to run on-device, at the edge, on a razor-thin power budget — then push results back to our operations center. Designing the compute-and-power architecture that makes this possible is the heart of the role.

    The mandate is simple and uncompromising: get reliable hardware in the water fast, and start collecting data. Every week of persistent at-sea operation compounds. The hardware is the gate to all of it.

    What you'll own

    • Common system architecture across the platforms: power, sensing, compute, and communications.

    • The edge-AI compute platform — selecting and integrating the processors and accelerators that run our in-house detection models on-device, and extracting maximum inference from every milliwatt.

    • Electronics design and integration — power distribution, battery systems, motor/thruster control, sensor interfaces (acoustic, pressure, IMU, GNSS, AIS).

    About Mistral

    Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

    We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

    The team

    Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

    We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

    European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

    The Role

    This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

    You will lead the team building our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU.

    On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you own it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own.

    That tension is the product: scale-to-zero economics with cold starts in milliseconds, autoscaling that absorbs a launch spike without a config change, GPUs scheduled onto containers the way other platforms schedule CPU. The customers betting on this layer are the developers building the next generation of AI software on European infrastructure.

    What You Will Do

    • Own the container platform end to end: image delivery, placement, request routing, scale-up, scale-to-zero — across CPU and GPU.

    • Make cold starts a solved problem: snapshotting, prewarming, image-layer caching, whatever it takes for scale-from-zero to feel instant.

    • Treat AI workloads as the normal case: GPU-backed containers, streaming responses, long-lived connections, MCP servers that cost almost nothing while idle.

    • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

    • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

    • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

    • Partner with Product Managers to turn platform decisions into a product developers want to deploy on.

    What We're Looking For

    • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

    • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

    • You have built container or workload platforms — orchestration, scheduling, isolation, request routing — not just deployed onto someone else's serverless platform.

    • Deep Linux: namespaces, cgroups, image layers, page cache — comfortable well below the application layer.

    • Multi-tenancy instincts: density, isolation, and fairness when hundreds of customers share one fleet.

    • Significant experience building complex backend or infrastructure systems.

    • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

    • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

    Hi, we’re Back Market.

    We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

    Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

    Are you ready to join us?

    As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system

    You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers.

    Your mandate has two sides:

    • Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable.

    • People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made.

    What you'll do

    Build and lead the hub

    • Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability.

    • Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team.

    Own Total Rewards and compensation

    • Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning.

    • Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes.

    • Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

    Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE)

    • Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal.

    • Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity.

    Turn People data into decisions

    • Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards.

    • Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions.

    Shape benefits and international mobility

    • Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally.

    Keep it trustworthy

    • Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early.

    What you'll bring

    • Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus.

    • Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle.

    This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in France.

    Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


    Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.

    The Role

    We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

    From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen.     • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

    • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

    • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

    • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

    • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

    • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

    • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

    • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

    • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

    What We Offer

    • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

    • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

    • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

    We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

    This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

    On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

    This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

    You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

    In this role you will

    • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

    • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

    • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

    • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

    • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

    • Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

    • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

    • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

    • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

    • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

    • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

    Requirements

    • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

    • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

    • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

    • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

    • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

    • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

    • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

    • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

    • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

    • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

    • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

    Bonus points

    • Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

    • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

    • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

    • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

    • Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

    Location

    This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

    You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

    As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

    As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

    What You’ll Do

    · Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

    · Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

    · Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

    · Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

    · Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

    · Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

    · Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

    · Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

    Requirements

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

    · 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

    · Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

    · Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

    · Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

    · Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

    · Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

    · Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

    · Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

                                                                                                                        About Linro<\/strong><\/h2>

                                                                                                                        Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                        Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production.                                                                                                                         We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota.<\/p>

                                                                                                                        <\/p>

About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. ·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours.

How to Apply

Apply directly on our website at https://codeforai.tech/

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Customer AI Engineer who will join our Token Factory team to help our customers successfully transition from proof-of-concept to production and scale their AI workloads on Nebius infrastructure.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, delivery, and customer success – ensuring that what was promised during pre-sales actually works reliably in production. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, Solution Architects, and Product/Infrastructure teams to drive stable, performant, and cost-efficient deployments.

This role is NOT:

  • A sales role (though you will support expansion through value)
  • A pure support role (you won’t just react to tickets)
  • A solution architect role (you won’t design systems from scratch)

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

Own the production journey

  • Lead the transition from PoC to production
  • Ensure customer workloads are deployed, stable, and scalable
  • Drive time-to-production and time-to-value

Ensure technical success in production

  • Understand customer architectures and use cases
  • Monitor and improve:

    - performance (latency, throughput)

    - cost efficiency

    - reliability

  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks proactively

Act as a trusted technical partner

  • Work directly with customer engineering teams
  • Provide guidance on best practices and optimisation
  • Translate technical challenges into actionable solutions

Manage risks and incidents

  • Act as a primary technical contact for production issues
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve incidents
  • Communicate clearly during high-pressure situations

Drive continuous improvement

  • Identify opportunities to optimise and expand usage
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Infrastructure teams
  • Help shape better solutions based on real customer needs

We expect you to have:

Technical background

  • Practical knowledge of inference frameworks (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of:

    - cloud or infrastructure systems

    - distributed systems or high-load applications
    - AI/ML workloads (LLMs, inference, etc.) is a strong plus

  • Ability to troubleshoot and reason about system performance

Customer-facing experience

  • Experience working directly with technical customers (e.g. engineers, ML teams)
  • Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and effectively

Ownership & execution

  • Strong sense of ownership – you drive outcomes, not just tasks
  • Ability to manage multiple customers and priorities
  • Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU workloads or AI infrastructure
  • Background in solutions engineering, SRE, or technical support in B2B environments

Key employee benefits in the US:

  • Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$209,800—$262,200 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products. Our mission is to unlock DeFi for the world by providing seamless, enterprise-grade integrations for modern finance. Veda's technology powers many of DeFi's largest vault products, including Liquid, PlasmaUSD Vault, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH.
At $6B in TVL and 100k+ users, Veda is one of the fastest growing DeFi protocols with a team passionate about DeFi and dedicated to our work. This role will be high impact and have the opportunity to directly shape some of the most critical infrastructure in DeFi.

Role:

We’re seeking a Backend Engineer to design, build, and scale the core services powering Veda’s platform. You’ll work across a modern, service-based architecture to deliver reliable, performant systems that power yield products for some of the largest names in DeFi and fintech.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with a strong sense of ownership, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and experienced in taking products from concept to production. You’ll work 70–80% in code, contributing directly to system design, architecture, and implementation.

  • Design and build scalable backend systems powering Veda’s API and internal services

  • Continuously identify and drive improvements in system reliability, observability, and performance

Learning & Development

We offer stipends to support ongoing learning - whether it’s a course, a conference, or something else that helps you grow.

“Make every logistics journey your best one yet”

The Company.

Founded in 2014, Quincus is a B2B supply chain operating SaaS platform headquartered in Singapore. We solve today's global supply chain challenges with groundbreaking technology. Using AI and machine learning, we have digitized and optimized the logistics process while giving customers full transparency into their supply chain.
Quincus was founded by two visionary entrepreneurs who possess more than a decade of experience in tech. Chief Product Officer Katherina-Olivia Lacey is leading a tech revolution in this space while empowering women in the supply chain industry. Jonathan E. Savoir, Chief Executive Officer, appeared on Forbes' 30 Under 30 Asia List in 2020, and also serves on the boards of several startups.

Overview.

Quincus Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Quincus products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software engineers and research scientists. Quincus Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Quincus, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and focuses that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Job Overview.

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced machine learning engineer to join our team and help us develop and deploy deep learning and reinforcement learning algorithms at scale. As a machine learning engineer, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable systems for serving models, optimizing inference performance, and managing production workflows.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement scalable systems for serving deep learning and reinforcement learning models.
  • Optimize inference performance of deep learning and reinforcement learning models using techniques such as quantization, pruning, and distillation.
  • Utilize GPU computing to accelerate model training and inference.
  • Develop and deploy production workflows for training and serving machine learning models.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to design and implement machine learning systems.
  • Monitor and improve the performance of machine learning models in production.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest research and techniques in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or machine learning engineering.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (C++ or Java a plus)
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Experience with GPU programming using CUDA, OpenCL, or similar libraries.
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing platforms such as Kubernetes, Docker, GCP, and AWS.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or machine learning engineering.
  • Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and frameworks.
  • Experience with production deployment of machine learning models and implementation of APIs for big data.
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture and performance optimization.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
If you are passionate about developing and deploying machine learning algorithms at scale, and want to join a dynamic team working on cutting-edge technology, we encourage you to apply for this position.

      <title>Discord: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning (Safety)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco Bay Area (or Remote U.S.)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>
<li>You keep up with the industry trends and continuously identify new technologies to leverage to solve technical problems</li>
</ul>
<p><em><br>The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord?&nbsp;</strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p>
<p><strong>Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. </strong>We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.</p>
<p><em><strong>Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking&nbsp;<a href="https://discord.com/terms/applicant-candidate-privacy-policy">HERE.</a></strong></em></p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Bethesda, Maryland, United States; Remote-US-MA; Remote-US-MD; Remote-US-WA; Vancouver, Washington, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.</p></div><div>
<p class="markdown-p">You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-hybrid</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-VC1</p>
</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position. Additional compensation such as Bonus, Commission, Equity and other benefits may also apply.</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$233,100</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$366,300 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yiG-k0YX_sW10PiJk_xliDc3W-veJCrK/view?usp=drive_link">Privacy Notice</a> for more details on how we handle your personal information.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo may use a software-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available <a href="https://www.zoominfo.com/legal/nyc-local-law-144-notice">here</a>.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.</p>
<p>For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.</p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.&nbsp;</p>
<p>With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.</p></div><p>As a <strong>Client Strategist</strong>, you will be working with our biggest brands and be responsible for the end to end SMS strategy for a rotating group of customers. You will work closely with our Marketing, Product and Customer Success teams to learn best practices and use your marketing skills to drive consistent SMS revenue for select customers. You will write best in class copy on behalf of our customers to make brands stand out, and help brainstorm revenue-generating and best-in-class strategies directly with merchants to help them make SMS their #1-revenue-driving channel.</p>

<li>Strong analytical skills, with a data-driven, metrics-oriented mindset</li>

<h2><strong>What You’ll Love About Us</strong></h2>

<p><em>You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.</em></p></div>

</p>

<h2><strong>Framer Website Designer (Onsite – Presidio, San Francisco)</strong></h2><h3><strong>About Air Apps</strong></h3><p>At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal &amp; Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018 and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco, we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.</p><p>Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. <p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases.
